title: Pan-Seared Fish with Saudi Pilaf
description: A flavorful German-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish served with a nutty Saudi-style pilaf.

ingredients.name: Unique spice blend (e.g. Za'atar or Ras el hanout)

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt, pepper, and unique spice blend (if using).
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, prepare the Saudi pilaf mix according to package instructions.
Serve the pan-seared fish on top of the Saudi pilaf, garnished with chopped parsley and a sprinkle of Arabian coffee grounds (if using).
